paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁，在结构化状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间建立理论联系 [S1.p2][S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明SSM等价于半可分矩阵 [S3.SS3.p2]，并将线性注意力推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA） [S4.SS3.p2]，进而指出标量恒等结构的SSM与1-半可分SMA互为对偶 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于该框架，作者提出块分解的SSD算法，其速度比Mamba的优化选择性扫描快2-8倍，并允许更大的循环状态 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。作者还设计了Mamba-2架构，在语言建模上匹配或超越Mamba与开源Transformer [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化SSM与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为Transformer开发的算法与系统优化迁移到SSM，以构建在序列长度上扩展更高效的基础模型 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM的发展与社区改进Transformer的努力显得脱节，导致SSM比Transformer更难理解、实验，且从算法和系统角度都难以像Transformer一样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective.

method.text: 论文通过结构化矩阵抽象建立SSD框架，将序列模型分别表示为矩阵变换和张量收缩两种视角 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明SSM等价于半可分矩阵，从而把SSM的高效计算归结为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS3.p2][S3.SS4.p1]。作者还从张量收缩角度给出线性注意力的证明，并将其推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA） [S4.p1][S4.SS3.p2]。在此基础上，作者提出基于半可分矩阵块分解的SSD算法，对角块用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用低秩结构归约为更小的循环 [S6.p4]。

evidence.quote: We develop two broad frameworks for representing sequence models, one as matrix transformations and one as tensor contractions
Equation ( 3) directly establishes the link between state space models and the sequentially semiseparable representation
it will allow us to reduce the problem of efficient computation of SSMs (and other sequence models) into efficient algorithms for structured matrix multiplication.
The main results in this section are a simple tensor-contraction-based proof of linear attention ( Proposition 4.1), and our generalized abstraction of structured masked attention in Definition 4.2.
The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode, which can be efficiently done with matrix multiplications
the off-diagonal blocks can be factored by the rank-structure of semiseparable matrices and reduced to a smaller recurrence.

experiments.text: 作者在合成多查询联想回忆（MQAR）任务上评估Mamba-2，使用比先前更难的任务、更长序列和更小模型，并与标准多头softmax注意力及Based架构比较 [S9.SS1.p2]。在语言建模上，作者按GPT3规格训练125M到2.7B参数的模型，使用Pile数据集，比较预训练困惑度和零样本评测 [S9.SS2.p1]。作者还进行了速度基准测试，将SSD算法与Mamba的扫描实现及FlashAttention-2对比 [S9.SS3.p1]，并消融了块设计、多头结构和注意力核近似等设计选择 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We compare on a challenging version of the MQAR setup from, using a harder task, longer sequences, and smaller models.
Our baselines include standard multi-head softmax attention as well as the Based architecture
The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
Table 4 ablates these architecture changes to the block, which occur outside of the core SSM layer.
Table 5 ablates choices of the multi-head structure for the Mamba-2 architecture.
We ablate several variants of these suggested by previous works in Figure 12.

findings.text: 在MQAR任务上，Mamba-1表现挣扎，而Mamba-2在所有设置下表现良好，且即使控制状态大小（N=16）也显著优于Mamba-1；增大状态从N=16到N=64和N=256持续提升性能 [S9.SS1.p3]。在语言建模上，Mamba-2在困惑度和实际墙钟时间上帕累托优于Mamba和Transformer++ [S9.F9]，并在各模型尺寸上优于Mamba，通常匹配两倍大小的Pythia [S9.T1]。速度方面，SSD比Mamba的融合关联扫描快2-8倍，且从序列长度2K起快于FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。消融显示并行投影和额外归一化略有提升，多值注意力头模式表现最好，而所试的核近似方法未超过简单逐点非线性激活 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p2][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled ( $\mathtt{N}=16$).
increasing from $\mathtt{N}=16$ to $\mathtt{N}=64$ and $\mathtt{N}=256$ consistently improves performance on MQAR
Mamba-2 is Pareto dominant on performance (perplexity), theoretical FLOPs, and actual wall-clock time.
For each model size, Mamba-2 outperforms Mamba, and generally matches Pythia at twice the model size.
it is 2-8 $\times$ faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan
SSD is faster than FlashAttention-2 starting at sequence length $2K$.
The ablations validate that parallel projections to create $(A,B,C,X)$ saves parameters and performs slightly better than Mamba’s sequential projections.
Additionally, the extra normalization layer also slightly improves performance.
Strikingly, we find a large difference between multi-value and multi-query or multi-key head patterns
the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions for $\psi$.

limitations.text: 作者指出，相比先前的结构化SSM，SSD的主要限制在于状态转移A_t的表达能力，SSD仅使用略微更受限的对角A_t形式，以表达能力换取硬件效率 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者还强调SSD并不推广标准softmax注意力，也不推广任何没有有限特征映射ψ的注意力核变换 [S10.SS3.p8]。此外，作者表示不确定Mamba-2在MQAR上优于Mamba-1是架构的哪个方面起主导作用，这仍是未来工作的问题 [S9.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions $A_{t}$.
SSD differs only in a slightly more restrictive form of diagonal $A_{t}$, and trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency
We emphasize that SSD does not generalize standard softmax attention, or any other transformation on the attention kernel matrix that does not have a finite feature map $\psi$.
(We are not sure which aspect of the architecture is the predominant factor, which remains a question to explore in future work.)
